noun_definition: Sign in refers to the process of logging into the New Expensify app using a new Gmail account to access the onboarding flow.
User refers to an individual who logs into the New Expensify app using a Gmail account and engages with the onboarding process.
Step refers to a progression in the onboarding flow that the user is expected to reach after completing the initial action of tapping an option in the onboarding modal.
Onboarding refers to the initial user experience flow in the New Expensify app that guides users through setup steps after logging in.
Option refers to a selectable choice presented to the user in the onboarding modal of the New Expensify app.
App refers to the New Expensify application that users interact with during the onboarding process.
